title: Parro et al. (2017), Heat flow at present-day Mars and evolutionary frame of the Martian heat flows

links.label: Parro et al. (2017), Present-day heat flow model of Mars

publisher: Laura M. Parro, Alberto Jiménez-Díaz, Federico Mansilla, Javier Ruiz

statements.text: Parro, L. M., Jiménez-Díaz, A., Mansilla, F. and Ruiz, J. (2017), UPWARDS project, Universidad Complutense de Madrid
statements.scope: Surface heat-flow grids at the present day and 1.5, 3.0 and 3.5 billion years ago.

statements.text: A first-order model, not a measurement: radiogenic heat of crust and mantle, scaled with crustal thickness and topography and tied to the north polar lithosphere. The deposit publishes no separate method note for the earlier ages.
